content: iOS/macOS Safari moves AudioContext to non-standard 'interrupted' state on tab background, incoming call, screen lock, headphone unplug (webkit bug 237878, web-audio-api #2585). Must check state==='interrupted' and call resume() on visibility/gesture; if context was suspended when interruption happened it will not transition until resume() is called. Long-lived ambient loops keep playing on hidden desktop tabs (rAF stops but audio continues) — pause/duck ambient bed on visibilitychange.
